newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: New S.Africa satellite TV in foreign deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: New S.Africa satellite TV in foreign deal - paper.

text.p: The South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) has secured a 500 million rand deal with an international company for its new satellite television service AstraSat, the Business Day newspaper said.
It quoted AstraSat chief executive Gert Claassen as saying the SABC board voted last week in favour of his recommendation on a technology partner.
The details of the deal were being hammered out and the name of the international partner would be released next week, the paper said.
The foreign company would provide the encryption technology and decoders.
The news follows an earlier announcement that AstraSat's six channels would be launched by the end of the year.
The paper also quoted Claassen as saying talks were on track to sell a 60 percent stake in AstrSat and that a buyer would be finalised by year end.
